mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce echinacea metabolite levels and potentially decrease immunostimulatory effects; echinacea may also induce CYP3A4, creating bidirectional enzyme induction complexity.
action: Monitor therapeutic effectiveness of rifampin-based therapy and consider alternative immunomodulation; avoid concurrent use if possible due to uncertain echinacea efficacy and potential for reduced rifampin levels.
